Remark
[compactness from conjugate-radius control]

Source: petersen:page-0454 ↗ lem:pet-ch11-cheeger-injectivity-radius-lemma 1. ch11:11.6.13For complete or compact $n$-manifolds with conjugate radius $\ge R$, $|\Ric |\le \Lambda $, $\vol B(p,1)\ge v$, use the techniques of subsection 4.3 to show a lower injectivity-radius bound, hence compactness in $C^{1,\alpha }$.
